descricao_original: A cross section of a portion of a skeletal muscle fiber displays the large numbers of myofibrils filling the sarcoplasm. The single visible nucleus is located just beneath the sarcolemma. Each muscle fiber secretes its own external lamina, which surrounds the entire cell. 10,000x
